newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-PIENAAR FEARS FOR INTERNATIONAL FUTURE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-PIENAAR FEARS FOR INTERNATIONAL FUTURE.

text.p: Deposed South African World Cup captain Francois Pienaar does not anticipate playing for his country again while coach Andre Markgraaff remains in charge.

Pienaar, the latest big-name player to sign for ambitious London club Saracens earlier this month, was jettisoned by Markgraaff soon after he had taken over the running of the side from Kitch Christie.
Pienaar told BBC television on Sunday: "I don't think I will ever be involved again as long as the current coach is there.
"There were three selectors -- two of them wanted me but the coach did not."

Pienaar, who termed his Saracens move "a great adventure," believes he can recapture the form that made him South Africa's automatic choice as blindside flanker and captain since his test debut in 1993.
"During my two years at Saracens, I would like to prove a point by playing the best rugby of my career," he said.
"People will be expecting me to perform and I will disappoint myself if I don't."
